analyst.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank continues to show a healthy underlying franchise -- loan growth around 15%, improving asset quality, and strong contributions from its asset-management, broking and life-insurance arms -- but the stock is not cheap at roughly 2.1 times book value, and the bank is heading into a leadership transition, with CEO Ashok Vaswani stepping down at year-end 2026 and a successor requiring the Reserve Bank of India's approval. We see no reason to sell a well-run, well-capitalised bank, but the current price already reflects most of the good news, so we rate it a Hold pending clarity on the new leadership and the margin trajectory.
